Conformer-2: Advanced AI Model for Speech Recognition

Conformer-2 is an advanced AI model designed for automatic speech recognition (ASR). It builds upon the success of Conformer-1 and has been trained on a vast dataset of 1.1 million hours of English audio. The primary focus of Conformer-2 is to improve the recognition of proper nouns, alphanumerics, and noise robustness. It follows the scaling laws proposed in DeepMind's Chinchilla paper and leverages a massive amount of training data. One notable feature of Conformer-2 is its use of model ensembling, which reduces variance and enhances performance. Despite its larger size, Conformer-2 exhibits improved speed and processing compared to its predecessor. In real-world applications, Conformer-2 demonstrates significant enhancements in user-oriented metrics, particularly in alphanumerics, proper noun error rate, and noise robustness. It is an invaluable component for AI pipelines focusing on generative AI applications using spoken data, providing accurate transcriptions with exceptional precision and reliability.

ClassifyAI is a platform that enables users to create, generate, and classify JSON models using OpenAI's API.

ClassifyAI is a middleware that simplifies the process of working with AI models. It allows users to call AI models and retrieve structured JSON Objects instead of plain text.

To use ClassifyAI, users create and configure a JSON Object that specifies the structure of the information they want to retrieve. They then make a request to the ClassifyAI API, providing the input data and any relevant context. In return, they receive a filled JSON Object with the defined keys, containing the structured information they need.

For example, without ClassifyAI, an AI model may generate a plain text review about the BIKE 3000. With ClassifyAI, users can define a JSON Object to retrieve specific information from the review, such as the overall sentiment or specific features mentioned.

ClassifyAI also offers pre-defined global JSON Objects that cover various topics and provide structured information ready for use. These global models can be tested without an account on the ClassifyAI Global Models page.

In terms of pricing, ClassifyAI offers different plans to suit various needs. The Free Plan allows for 20 free tests per day and the ability to configure custom JSON models. The Basic Plan, priced at $30 per month or $300 per year (with a discounted rate of $180 per year for the first 1000 customers), offers 50 free tests per day, the ability to configure custom JSON models, and API access.

For more information and to explore the capabilities of ClassifyAI, users can refer to the ClassifyAI Documentation.

a method for transferring the style from a set of images to a 3D object. The texture appearance of an asset is optimized with a differentiable renderer in a pipeline based on losses using pretrained deep neural networks. More specifically, we utilize a nearest-neighbor feature matching loss with CLIP-ResNet50 to extract the style from images. We show that a CLIP-based style loss provides a different appearance over a VGG-based loss by focusing more on texture over geometric shapes. Additionally, we extend the loss to support multiple images and enable loss-based control over the color palette combined with automatic color palette extraction from style images.
